title: Design and web image search options
goal: One page fixes the flow and sets out the image-search provider options for the owner
acceptance: Owner idea 2026-11-26 in chat: "in future I will be able to recover a recipe or a hobo place, say it was without image, I will be able to put it in chat and tell to use that, or to find some on the web, propose (using genUI?) and save the accepted." Italian is required for every model-facing feature.

docs/decisions/item-image-attach.md: the flow (find the item, "usa questa" or "trovane qualcuna", propose in an image-choice surface, owner picks, NERV saves after approval), who stores what (recipes: NERV photos with ownerKind recipe; Hobo places: hobo:F-018's set-image tool), never auto-saved

NERV has no web search today (no provider in src/; egress-proxy.ts only filters outbound requests); the page lists provider options with cost, key, licence metadata and privacy: Wikimedia Commons API, Openverse API, Brave Search image API, Google Programmable Search, self-hosted SearXNG; a recommendation

Web images: source URL, licence, author and attribution recorded; preview thumbnails fetched transiently through the egress proxy and served same-origin (no third-party URL in the surface); the full image downloaded only after acceptance; 5 MiB and JPEG/PNG/WebP limits; search results and their captions are tainted data
privacy: Invented recipes, places and images only; web images are fetched only through NERV's egress proxy, the full image only after the owner accepts it; no secrets or API keys in Git.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed: one design page and a five-option comparison. Not a measurement.
